one_line: Fourteenth‑century Kashmiri mystic and poet whose vakhs shaped a shared spiritual and literary memory.

appearance.age_look: Appears in her late 40s to early 50s, slender but sturdy, with a calm, weathered grace.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Kashmiri complexion, fine lines at the eyes and mouth, straight nose, dark arched brows, and deep, reflective brown eyes; default expression is serene and inward-looking, with a faint, knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick, dark brown hair with a few silver strands, parted slightly off-center, gathered into a low bun at the nape and loosely wrapped in a soft off-white woollen headscarf (pashmina-like), leaving a few wisps at the temples.
appearance.costume: She wears a long, straight Kashmiri pheran-style woollen robe in muted dusty-rose with simple woven borders at cuffs and hem in dull gold and dark green, reaching mid-calf over a pale, undyed off-white under-tunic visible at the collar and lower hem; beneath, she has loose, ankle-length off-white trousers and simple dark brown leather shoes; a plain, soft off-white woollen shawl is draped over her head and shoulders, pinned neatly but allowed to fall naturally, and she wears only minimal jewellery: small silver hoop earrings and a single slender silver bangle on her right wrist.
appearance.signature: A small, palm-sized, worn wooden prayer-bead mala with plain round beads and a simple tassel, looped around her right hand or wrist, which she gently fingers while walking or sitting.

ref_desc: Lal Ded is a late‑middle‑aged Kashmiri woman with an oval, light brown face, deep brown eyes, dark hair in a low bun under an off‑white headscarf, wearing a dusty‑rose woollen pheran, off‑white layers, simple silver jewellery, and holding a small wooden mala.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Lal Ded as a dignified 14th-century Kashmiri woman mystic: late 40s to early 50s, slender but sturdy, with an oval light-brown face, high cheekbones, straight nose, and deep reflective brown eyes, her default expression serene and inward-looking with a faint half-smile. Her thick dark-brown hair, streaked slightly with silver, is parted off-center, gathered into a low bun at the nape and loosely wrapped in a soft off-white woollen headscarf that frames her face and lets a few wisps show at the temples. She wears a simple but graceful long woollen pheran-style robe in muted dusty-rose, straight cut and modest, reaching mid-calf, with narrow woven borders at the cuffs and hem in dull gold and dark green; an off-white under-tunic shows at the collar and hem, and loose off-white ankle-length trousers peek at the bottom above plain dark-brown leather shoes. A plain off-white woollen shawl is draped over her head and shoulders, layered over the headscarf and robe, falling naturally without ornate patterns. Her only jewellery is minimal: small silver hoop earrings and a single slim silver bangle on her right wrist. In her right hand or looped around her wrist she always carries her one signature object, a small palm-sized wooden prayer-bead mala with plain round beads and a simple tassel, slightly worn from use. Emphasize the soft, earthy palette of dusty rose, off-white, dull gold, dark green, and dark brown, and present her in calm, contemplative poses that show the full costume, head-to-toe, and the mala clearly from multiple angles.
